note: Memory tiers and writer policy (PLAN 4c nmmem; guide 7, 7.1). T1 working is bounded and in RAM; T2 episodic and T3 structural are on disk under memory/. Identity records are kept apart from the tiers.

T0.note: temporary notes: each note or recall hit is a use, counted once per run-day (a day on which the system ran); a note used on promote_uses run-days is saved as an episode, one unused for clear_run_days run-days is cleared (Luis Jake Gabriel III, 2026-11-12 19:07 to 19:15 UTC)

T1.note: in RAM for one task, dropped at task end; no count limit; its room is the physical memory available at run time

T2.note: kept by the lifetimes, never removed for size

T3.note: kept by the lifetimes, never removed for size

hierarchy.note: saved memory, most used at the top (Luis Jake Gabriel III, 2026-11-08 11:42 UTC); a use is a recall hit or the same item again; an active item used on core_uses run-days may rise; 1-core unused core_run_days run-days and 2-active unused active_run_days drop one level (Luis Jake Gabriel III, 2026-11-12 19:15 UTC); archive keeps everything
